n: Washtower™ 4.5 Cu. Ft. Washer And 7.4 Cu. Ft. Electric Dryer - Black Steel
desc: The LG Single Unit Front Load WashTower™ with Center Control™ and 7.4 cu. ft. Electric Dryer is a revolutionary laundry experience that combines a powerful front-load washing machine and a high-efficiency electric dryer in one convenient and refined unit. With Center Control™, you can easily monitor and adjust the cycle settings on both the washer and dryer from one location.
hl: Power Clean Big Loads in Under 30 Minutes¹
Power through larger loads in less time, thanks to five jets with variable sprays that deliver a complete clean in under 30 minutes¹.
Steam Refresh Clothes in Between Washes
TurboSteam™ technology in the dryer refreshes clothes in between washes and helps sanitize children's toys, decorative pillows and more.
The LG WashTower™ can also handle common household allergens that attach to your clothing.
Sleek, scratch-resistant tempered glass doors are complemented by chrome rim accents.
Unlike porcelain & plastic, stainless steel tub & lifters avoid chips that snag on & ruin clothing.
A Smarter Home Starts with the LG ThinQ® App
The ThinQ app offers control and convenience for smart LG appliances to help you simplify life and enjoy the comforts of home.
